{{Quote|I recently came across a corporate vault the Republic desperately needs to keep secret. Arak was supposed to bring me its contents.|[[Cathan Dru]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Arak Malkan''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] mercenary operating on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was hired by [[Cathan Dru]] to break into the [[Steelfast Data Haven|vault]] guarded by [[Revaak|Revaak's]] [[Revaak's mercenaries|mercenaries]], but was unable to defeat them and retreated after losing two of his men.<ref name="TOR" />
